ui_components.test: Test button borders, input fields, focus rings against their backgrounds

failure_examples: Medium gray (#a0a0a0) text on light gray (#f5f5f5) background → 2:1 → FAIL
Blue link (#4040ff) on dark background (#1a1a1a) → 1.8:1 → FAIL
guidelines.enforcement: Pre-build checklist (step 2f). Compare every color pair in mockup before phase-4 handoff.

guidelines.guideline: Visible Focus Indicators for Keyboard Navigation

details.requirement: Every interactive element (button, link, input, select) must have a visible focus ring when :focus or :focus-visible is active.

visible_focus.style: Can be outline, box-shadow, or border change

details.keyboard_trap: No element should trap focus (unable to Tab out). Test with Tab key alone.
details.focus_order: Tab order must match visual left-to-right, top-to-bottom flow

failure_examples: Button with no :focus styles → keyboard users cannot tell where they are
Focus ring same color as background → invisible → FAIL
Buttons in arbitrary visual order (right-to-left) but focus tabulates left-to-right → confusing
guidelines.enforcement: Pre-build checklist. Mockup must include :focus-visible state for every button/input.

details.requirement: When @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) is active, disable all transitions and animations.
details.applies_to: Page transitions, button hovers, loading spinners, drawer slides, toasts, all CSS animations

failure_examples: User has 'reduce motion' enabled in OS, page still animates on load → FAIL
Modal still slides in even though user prefers reduced motion → FAIL
guidelines.enforcement: Pre-build checklist. Mockup must include reduced-motion block in <style>.

guidelines.guideline: Form inputs must have associated <label> elements

details.requirement: Every <input>, <select>, <textarea> must be paired with a <label> via 'for' attribute (explicit) or by nesting the input in the label (implicit).
details.screen_reader_impact: Screen reader users rely on labels to understand what each field is for.
details.floating_labels: If using a floating/placeholder label pattern, still use a <label> element (keep it semantically, hide visually with sr-only class)

failure_examples: Text next to input but no <label> element → Screen reader cannot associate
Placeholder only, no label → Placeholder disappears on focus, user forgets what the field is
guidelines.enforcement: Pre-build checklist. All form fields in mockup must have labels.

guidelines.guideline: Images must have alt text or be marked decorative

details.impact: Blind/low-vision users hear alt text read aloud. Decorative image with alt text creates clutter.

failure_examples: Chart image with no alt text → Screen reader says nothing → user has no idea what the chart shows
Decorative bullet-point SVG with alt='bullet' → Clutter in screen reader output
guidelines.enforcement: Pre-build checklist. Every image in mockup must have alt text or alt=''.

guidelines.guideline: Use semantic HTML elements (button, a, nav, main, form) not divs disguised as buttons

details.why: Screen readers announce element role + name + state. <div onclick='...'> announces nothing.

failure_examples:
Submit
→ Extra work for screen reader user

Link
→ Not keyboard accessible by default
guidelines.enforcement: Pre-build checklist. Mockup HTML must use semantic elements, not styled divs pretending to be interactive.

details.requirement: All clickable elements (buttons, links, radio buttons, checkboxes) must be at least 44×44 CSS pixels on mobile.
details.applies_on: Mobile-first design (viewport ≤ 600px). Desktop can be tighter if spacing allows.
details.edge_case: Links in text (paragraph links) can be smaller if underlined and have ::before/::after pseudo-element expanding hitbox.

guidelines.rationale: Thumb + finger size. Too small → misclicks → frustration → abandonment.
guidelines.code_pattern: .button { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
failure_examples: Small close button (24×24) on mobile modal → Hard to tap → users tap outside modal instead
Submit button 40px high → Just under spec → users tap it and nearby elements accidentally
guidelines.enforcement: Responsive design rule. Measure every interactive element at 375px viewport. Flag any element <44px in phase 3.

guidelines.guideline: Interactive elements must be spaced ≥ 8px apart (min, 12px recommended)

details.requirement: Distance between touch target centers must be ≥ 8px to prevent accidental activation of adjacent controls.
details.formula: Distance = outer-edge-to-outer-edge + gutter. Example: 44px button + 8px gap + 44px button = 96px total.

failure_examples: Yes/No buttons side-by-side with 0px gap → thumb touches both → unpredictable behavior
Radio button options stacked 20px apart vertically but only 4px horizontally → accidental toggle of adjacent option
guidelines.enforcement: Responsive design rule. Check spacing at 375px. Flag dense layouts (form buttons, checkbox groups) in phase 3.

guidelines.guideline: Color must not be the only signal for state/error/success

details.requirement: Use color + icon + text + pattern. Red alone ≠ error. Red + ✕ icon + 'Error: ...' message = clear.
details.applies_to: Error messages, success states, validation feedback, status indicators
details.colorblind_perspective: 8% of men cannot distinguish red/green. 1 in 200 people experience achromatopsia (no color at all).

guidelines.code_pattern: Error: ✕ Email already registered
failure_examples: Form field border turns red on error, but no message → colorblind user sees nothing
Success confirmation: green highlight but no checkmark or text → unclear what happened
guidelines.enforcement: Pre-build checklist. Every error/success/warning state must have: color + icon + text.

guidelines.guideline: No horizontal scroll at 375px or 1280px viewport

details.mobile_375: Minimum viewport width for most phones. Content must reflow, not scroll horizontally.
details.desktop_1280: Old small laptops + split-screen. Content must fit or scroll vertically only.
details.test: Use browser DevTools. Set viewport to 375px × 812px. Resize window. No horizontal scrollbar.

common_issues: Wide data tables with 10+ columns → Add horizontal scroll wrapper (vertical scroll inside table only, not page)
Hero image 150% viewport width → Squash or crop at mobile
Dashboard grid: 4 KPI cards at desktop → Reflow to 2 at tablet, 1 at mobile
guidelines.enforcement: Pre-build checklist. Mockup must be tested at 375px and 1280px. No horizontal page scroll.

guidelines.guideline: Input field borders must have ≥ 3:1 contrast against page background

details.requirement: Input fields, select dropdowns, and textareas must be visually distinct from the page background.
details.common_failure: Light gray (#e0e0e0) input border on white (#ffffff) page = 1:1 = invisible
details.fix: Dark enough gray (#999999) or colored border that contrasts

failure_examples: Borderless input fields with placeholder-only labels → Users cannot tell if field is clickable
Input borders same shade as page background → Invisible form
guidelines.enforcement: Pre-build checklist. Every input, select, textarea in mockup must have visible border.

guidelines.guideline: Empty states must have explanation + CTA (not just blank screen)

details.requirement: When a list/table is empty, show: icon/illustration + 1-line explanation + optional CTA button
examples: No transactions: 'No transactions yet. After your first sale, they'll appear here. [Create Sale]'
No projects: 'You haven't created any projects yet. Start building. [+ New Project]'
details.anti_pattern: Blank white space with no text → User thinks the page broke

guidelines.enforcement: Phase 3 design spec. Every data surface (table, list, grid) must have empty-state design.

guidelines.guideline: Error messages must be clear, actionable, and not just technical

details.good: 'Email address already registered. Use a different email or reset your password.'
details.requirement: Every error message must: (1) describe what went wrong, (2) suggest how to fix it, (3) use plain language

guidelines.enforcement: Phase 3 microcopy spec. List exact error message text for each failure scenario.

guidelines.guideline: Loading skeletons must match the shape of the actual content

details.requirement: While content loads, show skeleton shapes that are the exact geometry of what will appear.
details.example: Before 4 KPI cards load, show 4 skeleton blocks (44px tall, full width). After load, fade them out + fade in real cards.
details.anti_pattern: Spinner + 'Loading...' → No preview of what's coming → longer perceived wait time

guidelines.enforcement: Phase 3 motion spec + mockup. Skeleton states must match final content dimensions.

guidelines.guideline: Primary CTA must stand out (color, size, position)

details.requirement: The main call-to-action (submit, create, buy, sign up) must be: (1) primary color, (2) full-width or 2× button size, (3) top of form or end of flow
details.secondary_actions: Delete, Cancel should be muted (ghost button, lower contrast)

guidelines.enforcement: Phase 3 component spec. Primary buttons must be visually dominant vs secondary.

guidelines.guideline: Dashboard data must be ranked P1/P2/P3; P1 must be dominant visually

details.requirement: KPI cards (P1): largest, fullest color, top of page. Charts (P2): medium size, supporting context. Tables (P3): below the fold, drill-down.
details.visual_weight: Size, color saturation, placement, animation all reinforce hierarchy

guidelines.enforcement: Phase 1 UX analysis + Phase 3 design spec. Every dashboard must have explicit P1/P2/P3 ranking.

guidelines.guideline: All visual values must come from CSS custom properties (tokens), never hardcoded in component styles

details.requirement: .button { background: var(--color-primary); padding: var(--s-4); border-radius: var(--r-md); }
details.why: Tokens allow theming, dark mode, and brand updates without refactoring every component

guidelines.enforcement: Phase 3 output. Pre-build checklist. `docs/design/<story-id>-tokens.css` must exist with all 6 categories before mockup HTML.

guidelines.guideline: Data tables must have <thead>, <tbody>, and <caption> (or screen-reader summary)

details.headers_scope: <th scope='col'> for column headers, <th scope='row'> for row headers

failure_examples: Table with no <thead> → Screen reader cannot distinguish headers from data
No <caption> → User doesn't know what the table represents
guidelines.enforcement: Phase 3 output. Every table in mockup must have <caption> and <thead>.

guidelines.guideline: Body text must be ≥ 16px (1rem) on desktop, ≥ 14px on mobile

details.requirement: Smaller text strains eyes, especially for older users and those with low vision
details.exception: Captions, metadata labels can be 12px if necessary

guidelines.enforcement: Pre-build checklist. Measure all text sizes in mockup.
